review_scope: Targeted primary-source verification; not exhaustive systematic review

sources.title: Active Terminal Identification, Channel Estimation, and Signal Detection for Grant-Free NOMA-OTFS in LEO Satellite Internet-of-Things
sources.verified_finding: Fixed normalized-energy factor beta=0.1; absolute threshold scales with the maximum recovered user energy.
sources.applicability_limit: Direct GFRA/SOMP; does not establish transfer-optimal value in AFDM.

sources.title: DNN-Aided Block Sparse Bayesian Learning for User Activity Detection and Channel Estimation in Grant-Free Non-Orthogonal Random Access
sources.location: II-B, III-D; PDF p.10 Table IV
sources.verified_finding: User variance (inverse precision) compared to threshold 0.1; noise precision learned.
sources.applicability_limit: Threshold statistic differs from normalized coefficient energy.

sources.title: Compressive Sensing-Based Adaptive Active User Detection and Channel Estimation: Massive Access Meets Massive MIMO
sources.verified_finding: Spatial BI-AD uses per-coefficient probability cutoff 0.5 and vote proportion 0.9.
sources.applicability_limit: Structured user model and domain matter; neither generic coefficient averaging nor equal AER error costs alone implies equal conditional miss and false-alarm rates.

sources.title: Massive Connectivity With Massive MIMO—Part I: Device Activity Detection and Channel Estimation
sources.location: PDF p.6, III-E Definition 1, Eq.(30) and following threshold; Eqs.(27)-(28)
sources.verified_finding: Analytic user/iteration-specific energy threshold depends on effective noise variance tau_t^2 and beta_n.
sources.applicability_limit: This is a fixed analytic rule, not SNR-bin calibration; effective AMP noise is not physical noise alone. HTML numbering differs from PDF.

sources.authors: Ayon Quayum, Hlaing Minn, Yuichi Kakishima, Haralabos Papadopoulos
sources.title: Non-Orthogonal Pilot Designs with Collision Detection Capability for Grant-Free Access
sources.verified_finding: Derives SNR/noise-dependent optimum pilot-tone energy threshold; explicitly compares fixed and dynamic rules.
sources.applicability_limit: Pilot tone/collision detection, not four AFDM JADCE solvers; performance claim restricted to their model and objective.

sources.title: LEO Satellite-Enabled Random Access With Large Differential Delay and Doppler Shift
sources.verified_finding: User aggregate energy compared to an empirical predefined threshold.
sources.applicability_limit: No reproduced numerical threshold schedule or calibration protocol found; a single symbol does not prove a common value across every SNR.

sources.title: Learning Sparsity Pattern: An Adaptive Joint Detection for AFDM Grant-Free System in LEO Satellites Communication
sources.verified_finding: Normalized coefficient-block energy compared to eta; per-SNR network training is separately described.
sources.applicability_limit: Numerical eta, SNR schedule and calibration protocol not specified; historical project eta is not author eta.

sources.authors: Chang Cai, Wenjun Jiang, Xiaojun Yuan, Ying-Jun Angela Zhang
sources.title: Joint Activity Detection and Channel Estimation for Massive Connectivity: Where Message Passing Meets Score-Based Generative Priors
sources.verified_finding: Threshold applied to user posterior activity probability, including prior and effective Gaussian message variances.
sources.applicability_limit: Do not identify posterior probability with max-normalized energy; numerical cutoff is not established by this excerpt.

sources.title: Multiuser Detection Using Interference Suppression Filters in Uplink LDS-OFDM
sources.location: Publisher full text Section 4, Fig.4 paragraph
sources.verified_finding: Per-SNR search over epsilon in [1,2] for a normalized-amplitude threshold benchmark; authors explicitly call selection impractical.
sources.applicability_limit: An optimized performance reference is not the same as independently calibrated receiver-available SNR dispatch.

quality_note: Primary formulas and experimental protocols, theoretical assumptions and directness assessed separately; clinical evidence ranking not applied.
